name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
provider: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
description: Centrally sponsored scheme to arrest drop-out of meritorious students at class 8 and encourage them to continue studies from class 9 to 12 in secondary and higher secondary schools.
award_amount: ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month)
required_documents: Income Certificate from competent revenue officer (< ₹3.5 Lakhs)
Bonafide certificate from Government or Govt-aided secondary school
steps_to_apply: Qualify the State-level NMMSS selection test conducted by SCERT
Register on NSP portal (scholarships.gov.in) with OTR
Select Department of School Education and submit school details
Direct DBT transfer into student's Aadhaar-linked bank account

name: Centrally Sponsored Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. of India
description: Financial aid for Scheduled Caste students studying in Class 9 and 10 to minimize drop-out rates and build foundational secondary education.
award_amount: ₹3,500 to ₹7,000 per annum + book grant
required_documents: Caste Certificate (SC) issued by Sub-Divisional Magistrate/Tehsildar
steps_to_apply: Register on NSP or respective State Pre-Matric Portal
Fill student particulars and upload verified caste certificate
Headmaster/Principal verifies application digitally
Funds transferred directly via DBT to Aadhaar-enabled bank account

name: CBSE Merit Scholarship Scheme for Single Girl Child
provider: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)
description: Recognition of meritorious Single Girl Children who have passed Class 10 CBSE Board Examination with 60% or more and are pursuing Class 11 and 12.
award_amount: ₹500 per month (₹6,000 per annum for 2 years)
required_documents: Affidavit on ₹50 stamp paper from parents duly attested by SDM/First Class Magistrate verifying single girl child status
Proof of admission in Class 11 in a CBSE-affiliated school with tuition fee not exceeding ₹1,500/month
steps_to_apply: Visit cbse.gov.in Single Girl Child Scholarship portal
Enter CBSE Class 10 Roll number and Certificate number to verify scores
Upload notarized Single Girl Child affidavit and Class 11 verification form
School Principal e-attests and forwards application to CBSE

name: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India (PM-YASASVI)
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. of India
description: High-value scholarship for meritorious OBC, EBC, and Nomadic (DNT) students studying in top-class identified schools across India for Class 9 to 12.
award_amount: Up to ₹75,000/year (Class 9-10) and ₹1,25,000/year (Class 11-12)
required_documents: Qualifying Class 8 or Class 10 passing marksheet
Admission proof in Top-Class School designated by Ministry
steps_to_apply: Apply through National Scholarship Portal under PM-YASASVI section
Submit school credentials and category validation
School verifies admission in top-school quota
Disbursement through direct benefit transfer (DBT)

name: Vidyadhan Scholarship Scheme for 10th Passed Meritorious Students
provider: Sarojini Damodaran Foundation (SDF)
description: Empowering economically challenged students who scored high marks in 10th board exams to continue Class 11, 12, and onward into college degree programs.
award_amount: ₹10,000 to ₹60,000 per annum through 12th and Degree

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)

required_documents: 10th standard SSLC / CBSE / ICSE marksheet with >= 75%
Income certificate from competent authority (< ₹2 Lakhs)
Proof of admission in Class 11 or Polytechnic Diploma
steps_to_apply: Register an account on vidyadhan.org
Upload 10th marksheet and verified family income certificate
Shortlisted candidates take an online test and video interview
Continuous mentoring and scholarship awarded through degree completion

name: Santoor Women's Scholarship for Rural Girl Students
provider: Wipro Cares & Azim Premji Foundation
description: Financial support exclusively for young women from underprivileged and rural backgrounds who completed 10th & 12th in government schools to pursue 3-4 year degree courses.
award_amount: ₹24,000 per annum until graduation

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)

required_documents: 12th standard passing marksheet from government PU/Junior college
Admission fee receipt for 1st year full-time undergraduate degree
steps_to_apply: Fill online application on santoorscholarship.com
Verify that 10th & 12th education were completed in state government schools
Upload admission letter and college identity proof
Direct disbursement into student's personal bank account

name: National Apprenticeship & ITI Technical Skill Scholarship
provider: Directorate General of Training (DGT), Ministry of Skill Development
description: Skill training incentive for 10th pass youth pursuing 1-year or 2-year National Trade Certificate (NTC) courses in Government and Private ITIs.
award_amount: Full Tuition Fee Waiver + ₹1,500/month monthly stipend
steps_to_apply: Submit ITI enrollment registration through state technical admission portal
Nodal ITI officer validates trade enrollment and attendance (min 80%)
Stipend transferred directly through DBT under National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
provider: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
description: Financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet day-to-day expenses while pursuing graduate and postgraduate studies.
award_amount: ₹12,000 to ₹20,000 per annum

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)
Postgraduate (Master's / M.Tech / MD / M.Sc / MBA / MA)

required_documents: Income Certificate (Issued by competent authority, below ₹4.5 Lakhs)
Bank Account Passbook seeded with Aadhaar
steps_to_apply: Visit National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Register with OTR (One Time Registration) using Aadhaar & Mobile
Select Central Sector Scheme under Higher Education tab
Fill college details, Roll number, and upload verified income certificate
Submit and submit physical copy to college nodal officer for verification

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. of India
description: Full tuition waiver and maintenance allowance for Scheduled Caste (SC) students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stages.
award_amount: Full Tuition Fee + up to ₹13,500/year allowance

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)
Postgraduate (Master's / M.Tech / MD / M.Sc / MBA / MA)

required_documents: Caste Certificate (SC) issued by Tehsildar/Revenue Officer
Current Year Fee Receipt / Admission Letter
steps_to_apply: Register on the NSP or State Portal with Aadhaar
Select 'Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students'
Upload authentic Caste Certificate with barcode/digital signature
Upload current college fee receipt and bank details
Submit online and track application status through Student Dashboard

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
provider: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Govt. of India
description: Comprehensive scholarship scheme providing compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursement and living allowances to tribal students.
award_amount: Full Compulsory Fees + up to ₹12,000/year allowance

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)
Postgraduate (Master's / M.Tech / MD / M.Sc / MBA / MA)

required_documents: Tribe Certificate (ST) verified by Sub-Divisional Magistrate
Hosteller / Day Scholar Certificate from Institution
steps_to_apply: Log into National Scholarship Portal
Apply under Ministry of Tribal Affairs section
Submit personal, institutional, and bank particulars
Institute verification followed by District Welfare Officer approval

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: Empowering young women to pursue technical education (Degree or Diploma) in AICTE-approved institutions with tuition and contingency grant.
award_amount: ₹50,000 per annum for all years of study

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)

required_documents: Centralized Admission Process (CAP) allotment letter for 1st year/lateral entry
Declaration by parents stating girl child status (up to 2 girls per family)
steps_to_apply: Open scholarships.gov.in and select AICTE Pragati Scheme
Ensure candidate was admitted through centralized merit counselling
Upload income certificate, institute bonafide, and fee receipt
Head of Institution verifies records on the AICTE portal

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Students
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: Financial aid for differently-abled students having disability of not less than 40% pursuing technical degrees or diplomas.
award_amount: ₹50,000 per annum towards fees and purchase of assistive devices

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)

required_documents: Disability Certificate (min 40%) issued by Chief Medical Officer/UDID Card
Admission allotment letter in AICTE recognized technical institute
steps_to_apply: Select AICTE Saksham Scheme on National Scholarship Portal
Upload valid UDID (Unique Disability ID) or medical board certificate
Submit institutional verification form
DBT transfer directly to student's bank account upon approval

name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship for Minority Girls
provider: Maulana Azad Education Foundation, Ministry of Minority Affairs
description: Scholarship for meritorious girl students belonging to notified minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi).
award_amount: ₹5,000 to ₹6,000 per annum
required_documents: Marksheet of previous qualifying class with >=50%
School verification certificate signed by Principal
steps_to_apply: Register on the Begum Hazrat Mahal portal or NSP
Fill student profile and select minority religious status
Download School Verification Form, get Principal signature and stamp
Scan and upload verified form along with marksheet and income certificate
Final submission requires no hard copy by post

name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Professional and Technical Courses
provider: Ministry of Minority Affairs, Govt. of India
description: Provides financial aid to poor and meritorious minority students pursuing professional and technical graduation or master degrees.
award_amount: ₹20,000 to ₹30,000 per annum (Full Course Fee for Listed Institutes)

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)
Postgraduate (Master's / M.Tech / MD / M.Sc / MBA / MA)

required_documents: Income Certificate from competent revenue authority (<= ₹2.5 Lakhs)
Proof of admission to recognized technical/professional degree course
Fee receipt of current academic semester/year
steps_to_apply: Login to NSP, select Ministry of Minority Affairs tab
Fill institute admission and fee particulars
Verify that bank details match Aadhaar name exactly
College verification of technical course recognition

name: Indira Gandhi PG Scholarship for Single Girl Child
provider: University Grants Commission (UGC)
description: Supports postgraduate education of only girl children in families, promoting female higher education and gender equality.
award_amount: ₹36,200 per annum for 2 years (₹3,100 per month)

education_levels: Postgraduate (Master's / M.Tech / MD / M.Sc / MBA / MA)

required_documents: Affidavit on ₹50 stamp paper from parents duly attested by SDM/First Class Magistrate verifying single girl child status
Postgraduate 1st year admission proof in non-professional regular master course
steps_to_apply: Register on NSP under UGC Schemes
Upload legally notarized Single Girl Child affidavit
Institution head validates admission in regular Master's degree (age <= 30 at admission)
Scholarship disbursed quarterly directly into bank account

name: CSIR-UGC Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) & NET
provider: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) & UGC
description: Prestigious national fellowship for pursuing PhD research in science, engineering, and medical faculties in Indian universities and research institutes.
award_amount: ₹37,000/month (JRF) + ₹42,000/month (SRF) + ₹20,000/yr Contingency
required_documents: Master's Degree (M.Sc / M.Tech / MBBS / Integrated BS-MS) marksheet (min 55%, 50% SC/ST)
CSIR-UGC NET JRF Scorecard / Rank Award Letter
PhD Enrollment Letter in recognized university
steps_to_apply: Appear and qualify Joint CSIR-UGC NET examination for JRF
Enroll in PhD program within 2 years of qualifying
Submit Joining Report through university fellowship coordinator
Monthly DBT stipend through Canara Bank scholarship portal

name: ICMR Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) in Biomedical Sciences
provider: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Govt. of India
description: Fellowships to young scientists to pursue PhD in biomedical, life sciences, and social sciences related to public health and epidemiology.
award_amount: ₹37,000 per month + ₹20,000 annual contingency grant
steps_to_apply: Qualify annual ICMR-JRF national entrance exam
Secure PhD admission in recognized medical/scientific institution
Submit research proposal and fellowship activation documents

name: National Overseas Scholarship (NOS) for Higher Studies Abroad
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. of India
description: Full financial support to low-income SC, De-notified Nomadic Tribe (DNT), and Landless Agricultural Laborer students to pursue Master's or Ph.D. degrees in top QS-ranked foreign universities (USA, UK, Canada, Germany, etc.).
award_amount: 100% Tuition Fee + US $15,400/yr Living Allowance + Airfare

education_levels: Postgraduate (Master's / M.Tech / MD / M.Sc / MBA / MA)

required_documents: Unconditional Admission Offer from top 500 QS-ranked foreign university
Bachelor's or Master's degree marksheet with minimum 60% marks
English Proficiency Test score (IELTS / TOEFL / GRE)
steps_to_apply: Register on nosmsje.gov.in portal
Upload unconditional offer letter from recognized foreign university
Submit income verification, caste certificates, and visa documentation
Direct disbursement of tuition to foreign university and living stipend to overseas bank account

name: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship for North Eastern Region
provider: University Grants Commission (UGC)
description: Dedicated scholarship quota to promote general and professional higher education among youth hailing from the North Eastern states.
award_amount: ₹5,400 to ₹7,800 per month (up to ₹93,600/year)

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)

required_documents: Permanent Resident Certificate (PRC) / Domicile of any NE State
steps_to_apply: Apply through National Scholarship Portal under UGC section
Attach valid Domicile/PRC certificate issued by competent district authority
University verifies enrolment in recognized UG program
Merit list published based on class 12 performance

name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme (PMSS) for Wards of Ex-Servicemen & Police
provider: Kendriya Sainik Board (KSB), Ministry of Defence
description: Encouraging higher technical and professional education for dependent wards and widows of deceased or retired armed forces and police personnel.
award_amount: ₹3,000/month for girls (₹36,000/yr), ₹2,500/month for boys (₹30,000/yr)

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)

required_documents: Service Certificate / Gallantry Award Proof (if applicable)
Class 12 / Diploma marksheet with minimum 60% marks
Bonafide certificate issued by Vice-Chancellor / Dean of Institute
steps_to_apply: Register on ksb.gov.in portal
Select PMSS Scheme and enter Armed Forces service details
Upload Annexures 1, 2, and 3 duly signed by Principal and Zila Sainik Board
Priority order strictly followed (Category 1 to Category 6)

name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship
provider: Reliance Foundation
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship supporting exceptional college students across all streams throughout their entire undergraduate program.
award_amount: Up to ₹2,00,000 for entire duration of degree

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)

required_documents: Proof of enrollment in 1st year full-time undergraduate course
Household Income proof (salary slips/ITR/tehsildar certificate, preference to < ₹2.5L)
steps_to_apply: Complete initial eligibility questionnaire on Reliance Foundation website
Take 60-minute online aptitude assessment test (math, reasoning, verbal)
Upload personal, academic, and family financial documentation
Shortlisted candidates receive fellowship offer letter

name: HDFC Badhte Kadam Scholarship
provider: HDFC Bank Parivartan
description: High-impact financial support for high-performing students from underprivileged backgrounds, including crisis support (loss of earning parent, disability).
award_amount: Up to ₹75,000 per annum

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)
Postgraduate (Master's / M.Tech / MD / M.Sc / MBA / MA)

required_documents: Current year admission proof (fee receipt / admission letter)
Family income proof (Salary slip, Form 16, or Income certificate)
Crisis document (if applying under crisis category: death certificate or medical proof)
steps_to_apply: Visit partner portal Buddy4Study and locate HDFC Badhte Kadam
Fill profile data, educational details, and family distress circumstances
Upload requested documents in PDF/JPEG format
Telephone interview rounds for shortlisted students

name: Tata Trusts Means Grant for College and Professional Studies
provider: Tata Trusts
description: Philanthropic financial support towards tuition fees for deserving candidates pursuing medical, engineering, and undergraduate sciences.
award_amount: Up to ₹50,000 partial fee reimbursement

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)
Postgraduate (Master's / M.Tech / MD / M.Sc / MBA / MA)

required_documents: Original fee structure letter on college letterhead
steps_to_apply: Register on the Tata Trusts scholarship portal
Enter family details and upload college fee breakdown
Submit application before November deadline
Direct disbursement to institute bank account

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
provider: Department of Science and Technology (DST), Govt. of India
description: Attractive scholarship to attract talented students to natural and basic sciences (B.Sc, B.S., Int. M.Sc) and foster scientific research.
award_amount: ₹80,000 per annum (₹60,000 cash + ₹20,000 mentorship project)

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)
Postgraduate (Master's / M.Tech / MD / M.Sc / MBA / MA)

required_documents: Class 12th board marksheet showing top 1% rank in respective board
Endorsement certificate signed by Head/Principal of college
JEE Main/Advanced rank card or NEET rank card (if applying via competitive route)
steps_to_apply: Check board cutoff advisory note on online-inspire.gov.in
Register on INSPIRE web portal with official email
Fill online application form and upload endorsement form
DST reviews merit list and issues provisional sanction order

name: Kotak Kanya Scholarship for Girl Students
provider: Kotak Education Foundation
description: Provides financial aid to meritorious girl students from low-income families to pursue professional undergraduate degree courses.
award_amount: Up to ₹1,50,000 per annum until graduation

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)

required_documents: Fee structure and bonafide admission letter from NAAC/NIRF accredited college
Valid annual family income certificate (< ₹3.2 Lakhs)
Aadhaar card of student and parents
steps_to_apply: Apply through the Kotak Kanya portal on Buddy4Study
Provide authentic entrance exam scorecard (JEE/NEET/CLAT/CET)
Pass document verification stage followed by virtual interview
Scholarship granted for entire professional course duration

name: ONGC Foundation Scholarship for Meritorious Students
provider: ONGC Foundation
description: Flagship CSR scholarship for underprivileged SC, ST, OBC, and General EWS students pursuing 1st year of Engineering, MBBS, MBA, or Geophysics.
award_amount: ₹48,000 per annum (₹4,000 per month)

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)
Postgraduate (Master's / M.Tech / MD / M.Sc / MBA / MA)

required_documents: Class 12th marksheet for UG or Graduation marksheet for PG
Bank ECS mandate form signed by branch manager
steps_to_apply: Visit ongcscholar.org and select your reservation category
Fill online application with college details and admission merit rank
Upload attested copies of caste and low-income certificates
College Dean / Principal sends certified endorsement to ONGC

name: Adobe India Women-in-Technology Scholarship
provider: Adobe Systems India
description: Aiming to recognize outstanding female students in computer science and engineering, providing substantial funding and internship mentorship.
award_amount: ₹1,00,000 tuition grant + Internship opportunity at Adobe

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)
Postgraduate (Master's / M.Tech / MD / M.Sc / MBA / MA)

required_documents: Updated Resume highlighting coding projects, hackathons, and GitHub links
Letter of Recommendation from professor or mentor
Essay answering technical and community impact prompts
steps_to_apply: Access Adobe Research scholarship application portal
Complete the profile and upload resume + technical projects
Submit written essay on 'How you plan to innovate with technology'
Shortlisted candidates undergo interview with Adobe researchers

name: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP) Post-Matric Scholarship
provider: Government of Karnataka (Social / Tribal / Backward Classes Welfare)
description: Unified state scholarship for students of Karnataka belonging to SC, ST, OBC, EWS, or Minority communities pursuing higher studies.
award_amount: Full College Tuition Fee Reimbursement + Hostel Allowance

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)
Postgraduate (Master's / M.Tech / MD / M.Sc / MBA / MA)

required_documents: Karnataka Kutumba Family ID / Ration Card
RD Number (Revenue Department Caste & Income Certificate barcode)
steps_to_apply: Create SSP Student Account with Aadhaar and Kutumba ID
Fetch Caste and Income Certificate digitally using 15-digit RD number
Select College and enter University Seat Number (USN)
E-attestation of documents by designated college officer
Direct DBT transfer into bank account upon approval

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti (EBC)
provider: Higher and Technical Education Department, Govt. of Maharashtra
description: 50% tuition and exam fee waiver for Economically Backward Class (EBC) students of Maharashtra pursuing professional & non-professional courses.
award_amount: 50% Tuition & Exam Fee Waiver (Up to ₹50,000/yr)

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)
Postgraduate (Master's / M.Tech / MD / M.Sc / MBA / MA)

required_documents: Family Declaration / Ration Card (up to 2 beneficiary children)
steps_to_apply: Register on MahaDBT portal with Aadhaar authentication
Choose Directorate of Technical Education / Higher Education
Upload Tahsildar certified income certificate and CAP confirmation letter
College scrutiny and release of 50% tuition refund directly

name: National Fellowship for Students with Disabilities (NFPwD)
provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Govt. of India
description: Fellowships for students with disabilities to pursue higher education leading to M.Phil / Ph.D. degrees in Indian universities.
award_amount: ₹37,000 to ₹42,000 per month + Contingency Grant
required_documents: Disability Certificate with minimum 40% disability / UDID
Admission letter for regular M.Phil / Ph.D. program
Supervisor certificate and synopsis of research topic
steps_to_apply: Apply through UGC NFPwD web portal
Upload UDID card and University registration certificate
Selection based on academic merit in post-graduation
Disbursement through Canara Bank fellowship portal

name: LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship Scheme
provider: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)
description: Scholarships for meritorious students from economically weaker sections for pursuing higher studies in medicine, engineering, diploma or graduation.
award_amount: ₹20,000 to ₹40,000 per annum + special girl child grant

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)

required_documents: Income Certificate showing annual family income <= ₹2.5 Lakhs
Admission fee receipt for current degree course
steps_to_apply: Submit online form on licindia.in under Golden Jubilee Foundation link
Enter 10th/12th marks and father/mother annual income details
Shortlisted candidates submit physical documents to nearest LIC Divisional Office
Cheque / NEFT disbursement to student's account

name: Prime Minister's Special Scholarship Scheme (PMSSS) for J&K and Ladakh
provider: AICTE & Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
description: Full academic fee plus maintenance allowance for youth of J&K and Ladakh studying in colleges outside the UTs.
award_amount: Full Tuition Fee (Up to ₹3,00,000) + ₹1,00,000 annual maintenance

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)

required_documents: Domicile Certificate of UT of J&K or Ladakh
Class 12th passing marksheet from JKBOSE or CBSE in J&K
steps_to_apply: Register on aicte-jk-scholarship-gov.in
Attend document verification at designated facilitation centers in J&K
Participate in online AICTE merit counselling for choice filling
Take admission in allotted supernumerary seats in top institutions across India

name: Gramin Medhavi Chhatravritti (Rural First-Generation Scholar Award)
provider: National Rural Education Upliftment Trust
description: Targeted incentive for first-generation college goers from rural panchayat areas with outstanding 10th or 12th board results.
award_amount: ₹25,000 per annum + laptop grant for 1st year

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)

required_documents: Gram Panchayat Sarpanch / Village Officer Residence Certificate
steps_to_apply: Fill online rural scholar application
Upload Gram Panchayat rural certificate with official seal
Upload marksheet and first-generation learner certificate
Direct verification with local Gram Panchayat and college

name: Tamil Nadu Post-Matric Free Education Scheme for BC/MBC/DNC
provider: Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Dept, Tamil Nadu
description: Tuition fee waiver and special allowances for BC/MBC/DNC students of Tamil Nadu pursuing 3-year degree courses or professional degrees.
award_amount: 100% Tuition Fee Waiver + Maintenance Fee

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)
Postgraduate (Master's / M.Tech / MD / M.Sc / MBA / MA)

required_documents: First Graduate Certificate (if applicable for enhanced benefits)
steps_to_apply: Apply through designated college scholarship clerk or TN portal
Submit community and nativity certificate
Government reimburses sanctioned tuition fees to college on student's behalf

name: Uttar Pradesh Post-Matric Dashmottar Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement
provider: Social Welfare & Backward Class Welfare Department, Govt. of UP
description: Comprehensive fee reimbursement and monthly stipend for students belonging to UP studying in Class 11, 12, Degree, Diploma, and PG courses.
award_amount: Full Fee Reimbursement + up to ₹15,000 Annual Allowance

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)
Postgraduate (Master's / M.Tech / MD / M.Sc / MBA / MA)

required_documents: Income Certificate (Aay Praman Patra <= ₹2.5L SC/ST or ₹2.0L General/OBC)
steps_to_apply: Register on scholarship.up.gov.in using Aadhaar
DigiLocker verification of 10th marksheet and caste certificate
Fill educational, fee, and bank account particulars
Take printout and submit hardcopy to college within 3 days for verification

name: Kerala State DCE Merit Scholarship
provider: Directorate of Collegiate Education, Govt. of Kerala
description: State merit scholarship awarded to top students enrolled in government and aided arts and science colleges in Kerala.
award_amount: ₹12,500 to ₹15,000 per annum

education_levels: Undergraduate (Degree / B.Tech / MBBS / B.Sc / B.Com / BA)
Postgraduate (Master's / M.Tech / MD / M.Sc / MBA / MA)

required_documents: Income Certificate from Village Officer (family income <= ₹1 Lakh)
SSLC and Higher Secondary mark sheets
steps_to_apply: Log into dcescholarship.kerala.gov.in
Submit applicant profile and link with college admission number
Institutional verification by designated college scholarship coordinator
